name: DevSeek distributed agent loop eval
goal: Build programming-agent capability through independently runnable subloops before relying on real DeepSeek Web.

layers.description: Exercise AgentApplicationService with a local fake provider and assert AgentEvent ordering.
Exercise CLI JSONL output with the built-in mock provider.
Exercise CLI -> Bridge SSE streaming with a local fake Bridge.
Ask through CLI, receive a tool-style code artifact from fake Bridge, compile and run it locally.
Replay a captured loose tool JSON shape, recover the code artifact, compile it, and keep the protocol gap visible.
Optional CLI JSONL -> real Bridge -> DeepSeek Web coding smoke; the final chat.completed response is compiled and run locally.

promotionPolicy: A failing manual or real-provider case must first become a deterministic L0-L3 replay before the fix is accepted.
L4 proves the live Provider path is usable; it must not be the only regression guard for a logic branch.
A new feature can move up one layer only when the lower layer already exposes the same Agent facts and evidence.
Every run must write a testing report under docs/testing/agent-loop-eval-reports/<run-id>/ with findings, case-design review, and the next iteration decision.
If a run finds no DevSeek issue, the report must say what the current cases failed to stress and which harder case should be added next.
